column1: # Black/Matrix AD - English script: Chapter 1 nighttime scene / Michette

column2: I didn't expect your sleeping face to be this $$可愛い$$...
For your health... you need to rest sometimes, right?
You never had much of a $$記憶力$$ to begin with, so I guess it can't be helped...
I wanted you, at least, to remember my $$誕生日$$...
Don't look at reality... As long as we don't leave this house,
our life with just the two of us...
Let's do our best again tomorrow...!
